description: You are an assistive technology specialist configuring Talon Voice for a healthcare professional who needs hands-free computer access. The professional uses both NATO phonetic alphabet conventions and medical abbreviations daily. Complete the following two configuration tasks: (1) Update the phonetic alphabet list at C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\core\keys\letter.talon-list to use the full NATO phonetic alphabet — replacing the current non-standard phonetics with the official NATO equivalents (alpha, bravo, charlie, delta, echo, foxtrot, golf, hotel, india, juliett, kilo, lima, mike, november, oscar, papa, quebec, romeo, sierra, tango, uniform, victor, whiskey, x-ray, yankee, zulu). (2) Create a new vocabulary list file at C:\Users\Docker\AppData\Roaming\Talon\user\community\core\vocabulary\user.medical_terms.talon-list containing at least 8 common medical abbreviations as voice command aliases (e.g. stat, prn, bid, tid, qid, npo, icu, ppe, ekg, mri, cpr, dnr). Save all changes.
